# TSB Healthcare — Slot IQ™

> Slot IQ™ is TSB Healthcare's scheduling, arrival and intelligence platform for outpatient and ambulatory healthcare. It runs everything between the decision to book and the moment a patient is seated: online booking, an AI booking assistant, kiosk check-in, a queue engine, internal staff booking and analytics. It holds no clinical data (name, contact, appointment slot and ticket code only), is integration-neutral, and is paid for by the institution, never the patient. It has served BC health providers since 2018: 4 health providers, 69 sites, 4M+ appointments. Lab Online Booking (labonlinebooking.ca) is the province-wide lab scheduling service that runs on it. TSB Healthcare Inc. is based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.

## Product
- [Slot IQ platform overview](https://www.tsbhealthcare.com/slot-iq/): six modules, where it fits, onboarding, roadmap
- [Slot IQ Book — online appointment booking](https://www.tsbhealthcare.com/online-appointment-booking/): multi-site self-scheduling, earliest-available search, reminders
- [Slot IQ Assist — AI booking assistant](https://www.tsbhealthcare.com/ai-scheduling-assistant/): books, reschedules and answers questions by chat or SMS in the patient's language
- [Slot IQ Arrive — kiosk check-in](https://www.tsbhealthcare.com/self-check-in-kiosks/): QR/booking-code check-in, walk-in registration, ticket codes
- [Slot IQ Arrive — waiting room display](https://www.tsbhealthcare.com/waiting-room-display/): calls ticket codes, never names
- [Slot IQ Flow — patient queue management](https://www.tsbhealthcare.com/patient-queue-management/): one pooled queue, fixed dispatch rule, automatic no-show slot recovery
- [Slot IQ Flow — staff dashboard](https://www.tsbhealthcare.com/staff-check-out/): live floor view, call next, seat, complete
- [Slot IQ Insight — analytics and forecasting](https://www.tsbhealthcare.com/patient-flow-analytics/): utilization, no-shows, waits, recovery, demand forecasting by site and hour
